gates.placement_ok: every decoder/competitor mask: distinct physical CUs == requested, per-XCD counts differ by <= 1
gates.lifecycle_ok: every competitor: started event, stopped event, PID gone, no owned residual GPU process
gates.outputs_ok: Qwen32B pilot runs complete with one output digest across all CU levels and treatments
gates.leak_ok: v1, recorded only: probe TFLOP/s during decoder trials >= 0.85 x probe alone on the same mask
gates.leak_ok_v11: every decoder probe ratio (probe during decoder / probe alone) >= 0.85 x the highest ratio of the same probe beside a placement-proven native co-runner (fma or read) on the decoder mask, same GPU
gates.clock_ok: pooled in-window gfx and memory clocks over Qwen32B E2 pilot trials: max/min <= 1.05, coverage >= 0.5
gates.release_e2: placement_ok and outputs_ok (observational label if clock_ok fails)
gates.release_e3_full: placement_ok and lifecycle_ok and outputs_ok and leak_ok_v11 and clock_ok
gates.release_e3_minimal: placement_ok and lifecycle_ok and outputs_ok and leak_ok_v11
